description: This Java source file defines a collection of classes representing various temporal expressions, such as date ranges, day in month, hour ranges, and set operations like union and intersection, used for scheduling or date-based logic within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions
classes.description: A container class for various immutable and mutable temporal expression classes used for date and time evaluations.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.DateRange
classes.description: Represents a range of dates, encapsulating start and end dates.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.DayInMonth
classes.description: Represents a specific occurrence of a day in a month, e.g., the second Monday.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.DayOfMonthRange
classes.description: Represents a range of days within a month.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.DayOfWeekRange
classes.description: Represents a range of days within a week.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Difference
classes.description: Represents a set difference between two temporal expressions.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Frequency
classes.description: Represents a recurring frequency starting from a specific date.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.HourRange
classes.description: Represents a range of hours within a day.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Intersection
classes.description: Represents the intersection of multiple temporal expressions.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.MinuteRange
classes.description: Represents a range of minutes within an hour.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.MonthRange
classes.description: Represents a range of months within a year.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Null
classes.description: Represents an empty or null temporal expression.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Substitution
classes.description: Provides a substitution for an excluded temporal expression.

classes.name: TemporalExpressions.Union
classes.description: Represents the union of multiple temporal expressions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing or processing the expression.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the expression.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first calendar date that matches the expression criteria.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Checks if a given date is included in the expression.

methods.name: isSubstitutionCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a date is a candidate for substitution.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next date matching the expression after a given date.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the expression.

methods.name: getDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the day of week for DayInMonth.

methods.name: getOccurrence
methods.description: Returns the occurrence number for DayInMonth.

methods.name: alignDayOfWeek
methods.description: Aligns a calendar to the specified day of week.

methods.name: getEndDay
methods.description: Returns the end day of month range.

methods.name: getStartDay
methods.description: Returns the start day of month range.

methods.name: getEndHour
methods.description: Returns the end hour of HourRange.

methods.name: getStartHour
methods.description: Returns the start hour of HourRange.

methods.name: getEndMonth
methods.description: Returns the end month of MonthRange.

methods.name: getStartMonth
methods.description: Returns the start month of MonthRange.
